- Temperature change: 2500K - 300K = 2200K
- Heating rate: 2.2 K/ps
- Time needed: 2200K / 2.2 K/ps = 1000 ps

For LAMMPS with metal units:
- Time unit is picoseconds
- Need to run for 1000 ps
- Timestep is typically 0.001 ps (1 fs) for metal units
- Total steps: 1000 ps / 0.001 ps = 1,000,000 steps

Now I'll create the LAMMPS input script.

<action>write_file</action>
<action_input>{"path": "melting.in", "content": "# NPT melting simulation of Silicon
# Heating from 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data /results/10_feb_melting/claude_45/react/melting/subtask/level_1/brief/silicon_melting_1_subtask_structure_retrieval_trial_1/structure.data

# Replicate 3x3x3
replicate 3 3 3

# Define potential
pair_style sw
pair_coeff * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Neighbor settings
neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Timestep (1 fs for metal units)
timestep 0.001

# Initialize velocities at 300K
velocity all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian

# NPT ensemble settings
fix npt_melt all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0

# Thermodynamic output every 1000 steps
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press density

# Run for 1,000,000 steps (1000 ps at 0.001 ps/step)
# This gives heating rate of (2500-300)/1000 = 2.2 K/ps
run 1000000

# Write restart file
write_restart melt.restart
"}</action_input>
